name: manual_9b5f48
claim: orama-system's discover_endpoints()/last_discovery.json originally supported exactly one Windows LM Studio peer (endpoints.win) — tracking a second concurrent Windows GPU box requires an additive win_peers array (via $WIN_PEER_IPS), not overloading the single win slot, to avoid breaking lm_link_watch.py/lm_link_status.py which only ever read endpoints.win.

decisions.notes: A multi-machine plan called for running two Windows GPU boxes as concurrent AutoResearcher peers, but the original discover_endpoints() had result = {'mac': None, 'win': None} — a single win slot that a second peer's discovery would silently overwrite. Landed an additive win_peers list (probe_extra_win_peers(), wired through filter_endpoints_for_policy/compute_hash/save_discovery_state) as the minimal MVP schema extension; existing single-peer consumers are untouched.
